description: The file is a shell script implementing a custom Git mergetool, providing functionalities to resolve merge conflicts, handle special cases like symlinks and submodules, and invoke user-configurable merge tools.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if a file mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Checks if a file mode indicates a Git submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if local file mode info is present.

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if remote file mode info is present.

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if base file mode info is present.

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes a temporary directory for merging.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during merge.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a file based on its mode and state.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving symbolic links.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving deleted files.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a specific staged version of a file.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Creates versions of files with merge conflicts hidden.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function to perform merge on a specific file, handling all conflict types and invoking merge tools.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Prompts user whether to continue after a failed merge.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Outputs 'No files need merging' and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point that processes command-line arguments, identifies merge conflicts, and performs merges accordingly.
